# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 31 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale — New Price Record

- **First HDB resale flat to cross S$1.8M sold at SkyParc @ Dawson** - A 5-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson in Queenstown has transacted at S$1.818 million, setting a new all-time record on both absolute price and psf basis for the unit type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-s1-8m-hdb-resale-flat-in-singapore-recorded-in-queenstown/)

- **The S$1.818M sale sits S$588,000 above Queenstown's 12-month median** - The transaction is S$588,000 above Queenstown's 12-month median of S$1.23M and S$298,000 above the block's previous high, according to Stacked Homes analysis. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/skyparc-dawson-five-room-1818-record/)

## Condo Resale & New Launch Activity

- **Condo resale volumes rose 10.8% month-on-month in September 2026** - An estimated 1,093 units changed hands in September, with price gains largely driven by stronger performance in the Core Central Region. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-recovers-as-prices-continue-to-rise-in-september-2026/)

- **Hong Leong-TID JV wins Orchard Boulevard GLS site at S$1,755 psf ppr** - The joint venture submitted the top bid of S$181.86 million at the GLS tender that closed 29 October 2026, attracting five bids in total; analysts expect new homes to launch from S$3,500 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

## Land Supply — GLS Reserve List

- **Two GLS Reserve List sites could add 1,180 private homes** - URA has released sites at Chuan Grove and the former Raffles Town Club along Plymouth Avenue and Dunearn Road under the 2H2026 GLS Reserve List, with a combined potential yield of 1,180 private homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gls-reserve-list-site-chuan-grove-former-raffles-town-club-1180-homes/)
